title: Zetta-Joule team
description: A pale-blue section: navy label and statement, then portraits with a name and role under each. Desktop: a 4-column grid whose last tile is a double-width pale-blue card with a dotted field, a light heading and a link; each tile rises in as it scrolls into view. Phones: a snap carousel, one portrait per view with the next peeking, and two arrow squares.
notes: portraits are 328:458; empty shows a placeholder
has `relative z-10` and its own background so it slides over a pinned section above it
needs JavaScript only for the phone arrows
